readings.title: The Posture of Emunah
readings.subtitle: Relinquishing the illusion of control and resting in YeHoVaH's structural order.
readings.text:
[Psalm 131:1] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my heart has not been proud, Nor have my eyes been haughty. Neither have I concerned myself with great matters, Nor with those too wondrous for me.
[2] Have I not calmed, and kept my being silent, Like one weaned by its mother? My being is like one weaned.
[3] O Yisra’ĕl, wait for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Now and forever.

readings.title: The Architecture of Functional Harmony
readings.subtitle: The downward flow of the anointing and the commanded blessing of unending life.
readings.text:
[Psalm 133:1] See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity –
[2] Like the precious oil on the head, Running down on the beard, The beard of Aharon, Running down on the collar of his robes –
[3] Like the dew of Ḥermon, That comes down on the mountains of Tsiyon. For there <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded the blessing, Life forever!

readings.title: Magnifying the Name and the Word
readings.subtitle: Bowing toward the set-apart Hĕḵal in absolute acknowledgment of His truth.
readings.text:
[Psalm 138:1] I give <dn>You</dn> thanks with all my heart; Before the mighty ones I sing praises to <dn>You</dn>.
[2] I bow myself toward <dn>Your</dn> set-apart Hĕḵal, And give thanks to <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> Name For <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment and for <dn>Your</dn> truth; For <dn>You</dn> have made great <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> Word, <dn>Your</dn> Name, above all.
[3] On the day I called <dn>You</dn> did answer me, <dn>You</dn> made me bold with strength in my being.

readings.title: The Frequency of Absolute Truth
readings.subtitle: Earthly sovereigns recognizing the esteem of the Exalted One who sees the humble.
readings.text:
[Psalm 138:4] Let all the sovereigns of the earth Give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, When they shall hear the words of <dn>Your</dn> mouth.
[5] And let them sing of the ways of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For great is the esteem of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[6] Though <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is exalted, <dn>He</dn> looks on the humble; But the proud <dn>He</dn> perceives from a distance.

readings.title: The Right Hand of Deliverance
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH's active Right Arm extending through distress to execute perfect preservation.
readings.text:
[Psalm 138:7] Though I walk in the midst of distress, <dn>You</dn> revive me; <dn>You</dn> stretch out <dn>Your</dn> hand Against the wrath of my enemies, And <dn>Your</dn> right hand saves me.
[8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does perfect for me. O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting. Do not forsake the works of <dn>Your</dn> hands.

readings.title: The Omniscient Metric of the Creator
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH's complete mapping of human thought and action.
readings.text:
[Psalm 139:1] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have searched me And know me.
[2] <dn>You</dn> know my sitting down and my rising up; <dn>You</dn> understand my thought from afar.
[3] <dn>You</dn> sift my path and my lying down, And know well all my ways.
[4] For there is not a word on my tongue, But see, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> know it all!
[5] <dn>You</dn> have closed me in, behind and before, And laid <dn>Your</dn> hand upon me –
[6] Knowledge too wondrous for me, It is high, I am unable to reach it.

readings.title: The Inescapable Ruach
readings.subtitle: The shared life essence illuminating the darkest depths of the physical cosmos.
readings.text:
[Psalm 139:7] Where would I go from <dn>Your</dn> Spirit? Or where would I flee from <dn>Your</dn> face?
[8] If I go up into the heavens, <dn>You</dn> are there; If I make my bed in She’ol, see, <dn>You</dn> are there.
[9] I take the wings of the morning, I dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
[10] There, too, <dn>Your</dn> hand would lead me, And <dn>Your</dn> right hand hold me.
[11] If I say, “Darkness shall cover me,” Then night would be light to me;
[12] Even darkness is not dark for <dn>You</dn>, But night shines as the day – As is darkness, so is light.

readings.title: The Biological Masterpiece
readings.subtitle: Formed in the hidden depths according to the exact parameters of the Book of Life.
readings.text:
[Psalm 139:13] For <dn>You</dn>, <dn>You</dn> possessed my kidneys, <dn>You</dn> have covered me in my mother’s womb.
[14] I give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, For I am awesomely and wondrously made! Wondrous are <dn>Your</dn> works, And my being knows it well.
[15] My bones were not concealed from <dn>You</dn>, When I was shaped in a hidden place, Knit together in the depths of the earth.
[16] <dn>Your</dn> eyes saw my unformed body. And in <dn>Your</dn> book all of them were written, The days they were formed, While none was among them.
[17] And how precious are <dn>Your</dn> thoughts to me, O <dn>Ĕl</dn>! How great has been the sum of them!
[18] If I should count them, They would be more than the sand; When I wake up, I am still with <dn>You</dn>.

readings.title: The Rejection of Systemic Disharmony
readings.subtitle: A plea for the Creator to extract idolatry and establish the everlasting way.
readings.text:
[Psalm 139:19] Oh, that <dn>You</dn> would kill· the wrong, O <dn>Eloah</dn>! Depart from me, therefore, men of bloodshed!
[20] They speak against <dn>You</dn> wickedly. Bring <dn>Your</dn> enemies to naught!
[21] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, do I not hate them, who hate <dn>You</dn>? And do I not loathe those who rise up against <dn>You</dn>?
[22] With a complete hatred I hate them; They have become my enemies.
[23] Search me, O <dn>Ĕl</dn>, and know my heart; Try me, and know my thoughts;
[24] And see if an idolatrous way is in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.

readings.title: The Adversarial Snare
readings.subtitle: A cry for physical and spiritual protection from the engineered traps of violent men.
readings.text:
[Psalm 140:1] Rescue me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, from men of evil; Preserve me from men of violence,
[2] Who have devised evils in their hearts; They stir up conflicts all day long.
[3] They sharpen their tongues like a snake; The poison of cobras is under their lips. Selah.
[4] Guard me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, from the hands of the wrong; Guard me from a man of violence, Who has schemed to trip up my steps.
[5] The proud have hidden a trap for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set snares for me. Selah.

readings.title: The Verdict of Premial Justice
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH maintaining the cause of the afflicted and executing right-ruling for the righteous.
readings.text:
[Psalm 140:6] I said to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “<dn>You</dn> are my <dn>Ĕl</dn>; Hear the voice of my prayers, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[7] “O Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my saving strength, <dn>You</dn> have screened my head in the day of battle.
[8] “Do not grant the desires of the wrong, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Do not promote his scheme. Selah.
[9] “Those who surround me lift up their head; The trouble of their lips covers them;
[10] “Let burning coals fall on them; Let them be made to fall into the fire, Into deep pits, let them not rise again.
[11] “Let not a slanderer be established in the earth; Let evil hunt the man of violence speedily.”
[12] I have known that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> maintains The cause of the afflicted, The right-ruling of the poor.
[13] Only, let the righteous give thanks to <dn>Your</dn> Name, Let the straight ones dwell in <dn>Your</dn> presence.

readings.title: The Incense of Preparation
readings.subtitle: Establishing a structural guard against the delicacies of wickedness.
readings.text:
[Psalm 141:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I have cried out to <dn>You</dn>; Hasten to me! Give ear to my voice when I cry out to <dn>You</dn>.
[2] Let my prayer be prepared before <dn>You</dn> as incense, The lifting up of my hands as the evening offering.
[3] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, set a guard for my mouth; Watch over the door of my lips.
[4] Let not my heart be inclined to evil, To practise deeds of wrongness With men working wickedness, And let me not eat of their delicacies.

readings.title: The Oil of Righteous Reproof
readings.subtitle: Embracing strict correction while passing safely through the nets of the adversary.
readings.text:
[Psalm 141:5] Let the righteous one smite me Or reprove me in loving-commitment – It is oil on my head. Let my head not refuse it. My prayer is still against their evil deeds.
[6] Their judges have been thrown down By the sides of the rock, But they have heard my words, For they have been pleasant.
[7] Our bones are scattered at the mouth of She’ol, As when one ploughs and breaks up the earth.
[8] But my eyes are upon <dn>You</dn>, O Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. In <dn>You</dn> I take refuge; Do not pour out my life.
[9] Guard me from the clutches Of the trap they have laid for me, And from the snares Of the workers of wickedness.
[10] Let the wrong fall into their own nets, While I pass by.

readings.title: The Fainting Spirit and the Ancient Meditations
readings.subtitle: Remembering the structural works of YeHoVaH when pursued by darkness.
readings.text:
[Psalm 143:1] Hear my prayer, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Give ear to my pleadings In <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness. Answer me in <dn>Your</dn> righteousness.
[2] And do not enter into right-ruling with <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> servant, For before <dn>You</dn> no one living is in the right.
[3] For the enemy has pursued <dn>את</dn> my being; <dn>He</dn> has crushed my life to the ground; <dn>He</dn> has made me dwell in dark places, Like the dead of old.
[4] Therefore my spirit grew faint within me, My heart within me is stunned.
[5] I remembered the days of old; I meditated on all <dn>Your</dn> works; I ponder on the work of <dn>Your</dn> hands.
[6] I have spread out my hands to <dn>You</dn>; My being is like a thirsty land for <dn>You</dn>. Selah.

readings.title: The Plea for the Land of Straightness
readings.subtitle: Seeking the guidance of the Ruach and the decisive extraction of adversarial forces for His Name's sake.
readings.text:
[Psalm 143:7] Hasten, answer me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; My spirit fails! Do not hide <dn>Your</dn> face from me, Lest I be like those going down into the pit.
[8] Let me hear <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment in the morning, For in <dn>You</dn> I have put my trust; Let me know the way in which I should walk, For I have lifted up my being to <dn>You</dn>.
[9] Deliver me from my enemies, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; I take refuge in <dn>You</dn>.
[10] Teach me to do <dn>Your</dn> good pleasure, For <dn>You</dn> are my <dn>Elohim</dn>. Let <dn>Your</dn> good Spirit lead me In the land of straightness.
[11] For the sake of <dn>Your</dn> Name, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, revive me! In <dn>Your</dn> righteousness, Bring my being out of distress.
[12] And in <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, Cut off my enemies. And destroy all the adversaries of my life, For I am <dn>Your</dn> servant!
